exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - MUALLIFLIK HUQUQI BETI.

  ⚠ Inglizcha: 'the copyright page'.
  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami yo'q.


NAShRIYOT MANZILI:

  Liberty House      - bino nomi
  New Greenham Park  - hudud
  Newbury            - shahar (Nyuberi)
  Berkshire          - graflik (Berkshir)
  RG19 6HW           - pochta indeksi

  ⚠ Britaniya manzili: bino → ko'cha/
  hudud → shahar → graflik → indeks.
  ⚠ 'a county' = graflik (viloyat).


⚠ TELEFON: (0044) 1635 817 363

  0044 = Buyuk Britaniya xalqaro kodi
  1635 = Newbury shahar kodi

  ⚠ 'Tel.' = telephone, 'Fax' = faks.


⚠ 'INQUIRIES':

  'an inquiry' = so'rov, savol.
  ⚠ Brit. 'enquiry' / AQSh 'inquiry'.
  E-mail manzilida - 'savollar uchun'.


⚠ HAVOLADAGI XATO:

  Kitobda 'http: //www...' - ikki
  nuqtadan keyin bo'shliq. To'g'risi:
  'http://www.expresspublishing.co.uk'.

  ⚠ '.co.uk' = Britaniya kompaniya
  sayti ('.com' kabi).

exercises.explanationUz:
MUALLIFLIK HUQUQI MATNI:

  ⚠ '©' = copyright = mualliflik
  huquqi. 'Matn Evans va Dooley'niki,
  dizayn Express Publishing'niki'.


⚠ 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVED':

  = barcha huquqlar himoyalangan.
  'a right' = huquq
  'to reserve' = saqlab qo'ymoq
  (band qilmoq).


⚠ 'MAY NOT BE + V3' - TAQIQ:

  'may not be reproduced' =
  ko'paytirilishi mumkin emas
  'stored' = saqlanishi
  'transmitted' = uzatilishi

  ⚠ Rasmiy matnda 'may' = ruxsat.
  Majhul nisbat: 'be + V3'.


⚠ 'WITHOUT THE PRIOR WRITTEN
  PERMISSION':

  'prior' = oldindan
  'written' = yozma
  'permission' = ruxsat
  → oldindan yozma ruxsatsiz.


⚠ 'ISBN':

  = International Standard Book
  Number - xalqaro standart kitob
  raqami. Har kitobning o'z raqami.
  ⚠ Workbook: 1-84216-107-5.


⚠ SANALAR:

  First published 1999 - birinchi
  nashr; New edition 2000 - yangi
  nashr. 'an edition' = nashr
  (varianti).

⚠ 'permission' = ruxsat.

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS':

  = minnatdorchilik (rasmiy).
  'to acknowledge' = tan olmoq,
  e'tirof etmoq.
  ⚠ Bu yerda: suratlar kimniki
  ekanini E'TIROF ETISh.


⚠ 'WISH TO THANK':

  = minnatdorchilik bildirmoqchi.
  'wish to' = 'want to' (rasmiy).


⚠ 'THE STAFF':

  = xodimlar (jamoa).
  ⚠ Bir so'z - ko'plik ma'no.


⚠ 'CONTRIBUTED THEIR SKILLS':

  'to contribute' = hissa qo'shmoq
  'a skill' = mahorat, ko'nikma.


SURATLAR MANBAI - KINOLAR:

  The Man in the Iron Mask (88-bet)
    - 'Temir niqobli odam' (1998)
  Armageddon (90-bet) - 'Armageddon'
  Ace Ventura (32-bet) - komediya
  Cher (32-bet) - qo'shiqchi
  The Bodyguard (32-bet) - 'Tansoqchi'
  Tara Lipinski (32-bet) - figurali
    uchish chempioni (AQSh)
  Anastasia (87-bet) - multfilm
  Dr Dolittle (91-bet) - komediya

  ⚠ Bu betlar Workbook'ning
  betlari - kitob ichida shu
  suratlar chiqadi.


⚠ 'INADVERTENTLY OVERLOOKED':

  'inadvertently' = beixtiyor
  'to overlook' = e'tibordan
  chetda qoldirmoq.


⚠ 'AT THE FIRST OPPORTUNITY':

  = birinchi imkoniyatda.
  'an opportunity' = imkoniyat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  acknowledgements = minnatdorchilik
  the staff       = xodimlar
  to contribute   = hissa qo'shmoq
  a skill         = mahorat
  an illustration = illyustratsiya
  a photograph    = surat
  to distribute   = tarqatmoq
  an effort       = harakat, sa'y
  to trace        = izlab topmoq
  a holder        = egasi
  necessary       = zarur
  an arrangement  = chora; kelishuv
  an opportunity  = imkoniyat
